steps.content: Backstage, Luvia Ray taps her chest, trying to calm her breath from the intense dance.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I-I can't believe it. I actually pulled it off.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Is it possible... could I truly be the star of this show?
Luvia Ray, reminiscing the melody, begins to dance again, light on her feet.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: La, la, la~ Ahh!
With a sharp turn, Luvia Ray is startled to see someone suddenly behind her!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: You... You're... Lady Pearl!

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I'm glad you recognized me.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You see, my eye for talent never fails. You're definitely cut out to be the star of this show.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Gosh, about that... Even though I managed to pull off this act, I still think I'm not quite there yet, hehe...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: What makes you think that?
The elegant lady approaches, gently lifting Luvia Ray's chin, studying her intently.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Such a refined and pretty face, a balanced and vigorous body.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: And your acting is... absolutely enchanting.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You've got real talent for this, my child. You have that "everything" I'm looking for... in the star of this show...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Re...really? You believe I've got talent?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Absolutely.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: What is your name, my child?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I... I'm Luvia Ray! An up-and-coming actress from Eastside!
Lady Pearl chuckles lightly, her hand gracefully covering her smile.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Turns out, you're a pro...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Then that's one more reason why you should give yourself more credit... I heard everything very clearly.
Lady Pearl gestures towards Luvia Ray's heart.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Listen to the voices here. What version of "yourself" do you wish to become?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: What's your dream life like?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Say it, what's your choice?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: In this theater, whatever you choose, I will grant it.
Lady Pearl, clasping Luvia Ray's hand, looks deeply into her eyes.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I... I definitely choose...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: To be the star of every act in life!
Next, intermission time.
